referenceFidelity.findings: Original open-front capture-cradle brief is met. Rear frame/angled shoulder bridge and side winch pods provide an unmistakable mechanical silhouette, with restrained violet/amber identity. Root remains the captive foot origin and the positive-Z face stays open for Octocat readability.

construction.findings: Initial review exposed coplanar tray/footplate flicker and insufficient physical seating of side winches/power block. Repaired by recessing the tray below the footplate, extending side rails down to their seats, adding structural winch brackets and a rear power support stem. Personally inspected final GLB iso/front/side/rear/top and Inspector close/reverse: clean plate, connected pods/stem, consistent shoulders, no visible depth flicker.

readability.findings: The390px Inspector phone view retains the open captive space, violet tray/uprights, amber tow hardware and side pods. Front/oblique views show interior clearance for recorded Octocat1.836x1.8x.883; the surrounding frame is legible without a transparent shell. The rear plate is a secondary detail, not a required front-facing cue.

motion.findings: Static authored environment asset; no skeletal/object clips. Story placement, timed travel and force effects remain presentation-owned.

secondPass.findings: After the source repairs, the final r3 export was reassessed from front, oblique, side, reverse and phone views. Tray/footplate are separated without flicker; rails, side saddle brackets and rear module stem are physically seated. The open face and footplane are preserved. Integrated story captures at23.3/27s additionally show the carrier around Octocat at plausible scale, while timed travel stays presentation-owned.
